q: All particles of an object rotating around the axis of rotation move in a _____ path.
e: All particles of an object rotating around the axis of rotation move in a circular path. Each particle of a rotor travels on a circular path about the axis. linear or elliptical is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: All particles of the body move in a circle lying on a plane that is _____ to the axis.
e: All particles of the body move in a circle lying on a plane that is perpendicular to the axis. Perpendicular means the two directions stand at right angles. parallel or tangent is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The relation between arc length $s$ and angular displacement $\theta$ is $s = r\theta$ where $r$ is the _____ of the circle.
e: The relation between arc length s and angular displacement θ is s = rθ where r is the radius of the circle. Radius r links linear and angular measures through s = rθ and v = rω. diameter or circumference is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The instantaneous angular velocity $\omega$ of rotational object is the _____ for all the particles comprising the object.
e: The instantaneous angular velocity ω of rotational object is the same for all the particles comprising the object. Angular velocity ω tells how fast the rotation angle is changing. different or zero is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The relation $v = r\omega$ applies to every particle of the rotational object, where $\omega$ is measured in radian per _____.
e: The relation v = rω applies to every particle of the rotational object, where ω is measured in radian per second. minute or hour is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Since the direction of linear velocity is tangent to the path, the linear velocity is also called _____ velocity.
e: Since the direction of linear velocity is tangent to the path, the linear velocity is also called tangential velocity. Tangential means along the tangent to the circular path. radial or centripetal is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: If the magnitude of the angular velocity of a rotating object changes, the object will have a _____ acceleration.
e: If the magnitude of the angular velocity of a rotating object changes, the object will have a tangential acceleration. Tangential means along the tangent to the circular path. centripetal or radial is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The direction of tangential acceleration is always _____ to the circular path.
e: The direction of tangential acceleration is always tangent to the circular path. Tangential acceleration a_T lies along the tangent and changes the speed along the circle. perpendicular or radial is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The tangential acceleration $a_T$ relates to angular acceleration $\alpha$ by the equation $a_T = r\alpha$, where $\alpha$ is measured in radian per second _____.
e: The tangential acceleration a_T relates to angular acceleration α by the equation a_T = rα, where α is measured in radian per second squared. Angular acceleration α is the rate of change of angular velocity ω. cubed or inverse is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The tangential acceleration of a rotating object is a measure of how fast the tangential _____ changes.
e: The tangential acceleration of a rotating object is a measure of how fast the tangential velocity changes. Tangential acceleration a_T lies along the tangent and changes the speed along the circle. displacement or acceleration is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The direction of the angular velocity vector is perpendicular to the plane of rotation, and along the axis of _____.
e: The direction of the angular velocity vector is perpendicular to the plane of rotation, and along the axis of rotation. Angular velocity ω tells how fast the rotation angle is changing. gravity or friction is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The direction of angular velocity is usually specified by the _____-hand rule.
e: The direction of angular velocity is usually specified by the right-hand rule. Angular velocity ω tells how fast the rotation angle is changing. left or both is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: When the angular velocity is increasing, the angular acceleration vector points in the _____ direction as the angular velocity.
e: When the angular velocity is increasing, the angular acceleration vector points in the same direction as the angular velocity. Angular acceleration α is the rate of change of angular velocity ω. opposite or perpendicular is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: When the angular velocity is decreasing, the angular acceleration vector points in the _____ to the angular velocity.
e: When the angular velocity is decreasing, the angular acceleration vector points in the opposite to the angular velocity. Angular acceleration α is the rate of change of angular velocity ω. same direction or perpendicular plane is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: Wrap the right hand around the axis of rotation so that the fingers are pointing in the direction of rotation, the thumb points in the direction of the angular _____ vector.
e: Wrap the right hand around the axis of rotation so that the fingers are pointing in the direction of rotation, the thumb points in the direction of the angular velocity vector. acceleration or displacement is a different idea, so those options are wrong.
